theorem QOU.BraidKnot.trivial_vortex_vacuum_mass (U : UnifiedKnotMass) (h_desc : U.markovTrace = 1) (h_tower : U.tower = 0) :
U.total_mass = 1 + U.mE * U.coCasimirTrace

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.four_strand_frobenius_correction (U : UnifiedKnotMass) (hn : U.n = 4) :
U.frobenius_correction = U.mE * (2 + 2 / (U.q ^ 2 + 1 + (U.q ^ 2)⁻¹) + 1 / (U.q ^ 2 + (U.q ^ 2)⁻¹))

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.two_strand_frobenius_correction (U : UnifiedKnotMass) (hn : U.n = 2) :
U.frobenius_correction = U.mE * 2

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.knot_mass_unified (U : UnifiedKnotMass) (hn : U.n = 3) :
U.total_mass = |U.markovTrace| - U.tower + U.mE * (2 + 1 / (U.q + U.q⁻¹))

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.knot_mass_unified_small (U : UnifiedKnotMass) (hn : U.n ≤ 5) :
U.total_mass = |U.markovTrace| - U.tower + U.mE * partitionInverseDimSum U.q U.n

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.UnifiedKnotMass.coCasimir_small_n (self : UnifiedKnotMass) :
self.n ≤ 5 → self.coCasimirTrace = partitionInverseDimSum self.q self.n

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.UnifiedKnotMass.frobenius_is_codim_trace (self : UnifiedKnotMass) :
self.frobenius_correction = self.mE * self.coCasimirTrace

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.UnifiedKnotMass.tower_is_li2q_sum (self : UnifiedKnotMass) :
self.tower = ∑ i : Fin (self.n - 1), self.li2q (-self.vhat i) + self.z ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin (self.n - 1), ∑ j : Fin (self.n - 1), if i < j then self.li2q (-(self.vhat i * self.vhat j)) else 0

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.UnifiedKnotMass.descended_is_markov (self : UnifiedKnotMass) :
self.descended = |self.markovTrace|

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.UnifiedKnotMass.unified_identity (self : UnifiedKnotMass) :
self.total_mass = self.descended - self.tower + self.frobenius_correction

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.partitionInverseDimSum_five (q : ℝ) :
partitionInverseDimSum q 5 = 2 + 2 / (q ^ 3 + q + q⁻¹ + (q ^ 3)⁻¹) + 2 / (q ^ 4 + q ^ 2 + 1 + (q ^ 2)⁻¹ + (q ^ 4)⁻¹) + 1 / ((q ^ 2 + (q ^ 2)⁻¹) * (q ^ 2 + 1 + (q ^ 2)⁻¹))

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.partitionInverseDimSum_four (q : ℝ) :
partitionInverseDimSum q 4 = 2 + 2 / (q ^ 2 + 1 + (q ^ 2)⁻¹) + 1 / (q ^ 2 + (q ^ 2)⁻¹)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.partitionInverseDimSum_three (q : ℝ) :
partitionInverseDimSum q 3 = 2 + 1 / (q + q⁻¹)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.partitionInverseDimSum_two (q : ℝ) :
partitionInverseDimSum q 2 = 2
